description: Authentic uuidv7() input->id vectors from Pi packages/agent/src/harness/session/uuid.ts. crypto.getRandomValues was patched to the given 16-byte pattern and Date.now() to nowMs, then uuidv7() called. Byte layout: bytes[0..5]=48-bit ms big-endian; bytes[6]=0x70|(seq>>>28 &0xf); bytes[8]=0x80|(seq>>>14 &0x3f); bytes[10]=((seq&0x3f)<<2)|(random[10]&0x03); bytes[11..15]=random[11..15]. shortId = id.slice(-8) (bytes 12..15).
monotonicNote: Vectors run in array order against a single shared module. 'fresh-seq' is the first call (lastTimestamp=-Infinity). 'monotonic-same-now' reuses nowMs=1000 so it takes the sequence=(sequence+1)>>>0 path; its id differs from 'fresh-seq' only in the sequence-derived bytes and its own random tail.

vectors.label: fresh-seq
vectors.note: fresh-timestamp branch (timestamp > lastTimestamp); sequence seeded from random[6..9]

vectors.label: monotonic-same-now
vectors.note: same nowMs as previous -> sequence = (sequence+1)>>>0; only bytes 6..9 change vs a pure-random uuid

vectors.label: fresh-realistic-ms
vectors.note: fresh branch; 48-bit ms 1765233665292 packed big-endian into bytes 0..5
